**P177-N001, newly admitted work is not process-free:** formerly refused missing-line/no-docs requests now continue through the existing delivered/holding-release pipeline. The view is reached through the existing HTTP directory-view call; idle-review and call_on are in-memory picture/command generation, not a new scheduled worker or execution of those commands.
